messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: change of formatting of axis values upon using library(scales)
parts:
I'm pretty sure you can't combine the fill and shape legends, but I'll let the pros answer that for sure. You can get rid of the alpha portion with guide=FALSE. I also, mostly, fixed your expression. 

ggplot(NPP_long,aes(x=long,y=NPP))+
geom_point(aes(shape=area,fill=depth),size=7,position=position_jitter(width=0.98,height=1.3))+
scale_shape_manual(values=c(21,22,25,4,24))+
scale_fill_manual(values=alpha(c("#FFFFFF","#F2F2F2","#000000"),0.9), guide=F)+
labs(x="Longitude (°E)", y=expression(paste(NPP,~mg~C~m^-2~yr^-1, sep=""))) 


HTH, 

Brandon

P.S. You might want to change your shape scale. The shape "X" doesn't really have a fill so if your points differ they won't show as such.
